sources.title: Ministry of Labour and Social Security (Jamaica), Work Permit and Work Permit Exemption Application Instruction Sheet (2025)
sources.said: Jamaican Law requires all non-Jamaican nationals who do not enjoy diplomatic status to have Work Permits as long as they are engaged in gainful employment in the island, whether or not the form of gainful employment is voluntary, commercial, business, professional, charitable or entertainment and sport related. … Certified proof that the post was advertised locally, … and with the Ministry’s Labour Market Information System (LMIS), through the Electronic Labour Exchange (ELE) Unit should be presented. … A processing fee of $17,250.00 is payable for processing each application. … The employer is required to pay the Work Permit Fee upon receiving the Notice of Approval before the Work Permit can be issued. … When making an application for the renewal of Work Permit Exemption
